room_rent.note: Room eligibility (single private / twin sharing / general ward) fixed by chosen variant; copay applies if room outside category

copayment.note: No mandatory base co-pay; copay applies only if a higher room than plan category is chosen

sub_limits.note: Classic & Select variants cover mono-focal lens only; modern treatments up to plan limit

ped_waiting.note: Modifiable via PED Waiting Time Modification optional

cumulative_bonus.note: Unutilized Base SI carries forward, up to 10x Base SI (variant-dependent); not a flat NCB %

restoration.note: First paid claim triggers ReAssure Forever — unlimited reinstatement of Base SI for life of policy

ambulance.note: Road ambulance up to plan limit; air ambulance for emergency per hospitalization

global_cover.note: Borderless / Borderless for Specific Illness optional add-on — worldwide treatment, up to standard private room

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity excluded; treatment India only (unless Borderless); cataract mono-focal on some variants; standard Excl01–18

optional_riders.display: Borderless / Borderless Specific Illness (global), Claim Safeguard+, PED Waiting modification, Annual Aggregate Deductible
